note: Rule and market changes that alter what a counsellor should advise. Each one carries the date it takes effect, so the office can see what is coming rather than hearing it from a student. Verify against the official source before advising: the link is the point of the row.

movements.headline: Genuine Student statement weighted harder for first-time applicants
movements.whatItMeans: Files with a weak study plan are being refused earlier. Put the SOP work before the application, not after the offer.

movements.headline: Study permit cap continues, provincial attestation still required
movements.whatItMeans: Do not promise a start date until the attestation letter is in hand. Budget an extra intake of slippage.

movements.headline: Graduate route retained at two years for masters students
movements.whatItMeans: The strongest argument for UK masters right now. Expect enquiry volume to keep climbing.

movements.headline: NOC applications processed online only
movements.whatItMeans: Collect scans at enrolment. Files that still gather paper at the last minute lose a week.

movements.headline: Japanese language school intake demand rising sharply from Nepal
movements.whatItMeans: Searches up 46 percent year on year and few Kathmandu consultancies serve it well. A desk here is cheap to start.

movements.headline: Student visa application charge rises again
movements.whatItMeans: Quote the new figure in the cost sheet. A student who budgeted last year's fee is a refusal risk on funds.
